decay.note: Authored from botanical descriptions of bitter cherry: finely toothed blades 3 to 8 cm with rounded tips, on petioles of 0.5 to 1.5 cm, yellow to red in autumn and drying brown. Colours and curl chosen by eye; numbers plausible, not measured.
